section.title: Cool Down Activity
Student Activity
section.para: The graph above shows the population of a city from 1900 to 2000. Use the graph to answer questions 1 - 5.

list.item: What is the average rate of change of the population between 1930 and 1950? Be prepared to show your reasoning.
list.para: Answer: About 250 people per year. The population was 40,000 in 1930 and about 45,000 in 1950, an increase of 5,000 people over 20 years, which equals 250 people per year.

list.item: Decide if the average rate of change is positive or negative for the time period from 1930 to 1940.
